title: Newmark Expands Florida Project Management Presence with Appointment of Scott Florio
summary: Newmark announces that Scott Florio has joined the firm as Regional Project Management Leader for Florida.
body_markdown:
**September 15, 2026 11:00 AM**


Newmark announces that[Scott Florio](https://www.nmrk.com/people/scott-florio) has joined the firm as Regional Project Management Leader for Florida. Based in Orlando and reporting to Managing Director, Southeast Project Management[Richard Newman](https://www.nmrk.com/people/richard-newman) , Florio will establish and lead Newmark’s Project Management presence across Tampa, Orlando and Jacksonville, while leveraging Newmark’s statewide business and relationships to support clients throughout Florida, including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, Naples and Fort Myers. He will collaborate with brokers and professionals across the state to deliver integrated capital project solutions for occupiers, developers and investors.


“As our clients continue to expand into high-growth markets, they’re looking for project management experts who combine local market knowledge with the resources and sophistication of a national platform,” said[Eric Brown](https://www.nmrk.com/people/eric-brown) , Head of Project Management, Americas. “Expanding our leadership presence in Florida strengthens our ability to meet clients where they’re investing while delivering the consistent execution and strategic guidance they expect from Newmark. Scott’s experience leading regional teams and delivering complex projects makes him the ideal person to establish and grow our Project Management presence across the state.”


Florio joins Newmark with more than a decade of experience leading regional project management operations and complex capital programs across Florida and the Northeast. Most recently, he served as Director of Project Management for CBRE | Turner & Townsend’s North Florida Region, where he led teams across Tampa, Orlando and Jacksonville, expanded the business into new sectors, strengthened operational performance and oversaw projects spanning office, industrial, healthcare, aviation, infrastructure and higher education.


“Great project management is about understanding what clients are trying to achieve and helping them make smarter decisions every step of the way,” said Florio. “Florida continues to attract companies, developers and investors from around the world, creating opportunities across every major market in the state. While I am based in Orlando, our business allows us to support clients from Jacksonville to Miami and from Tampa to Fort Myers, bringing local expertise, national resources and consistent project delivery wherever our clients are investing.”


According to Newmark Research, Florida remains one of the country’s most dynamic commercial real estate markets, supported by sustained population growth, business expansion and long-term investment trends. Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville, Miami and Fort Lauderdale continue to attract corporate investment and development across office, industrial, healthcare and mixed-use properties, reinforcing the state’s position as one of the nation’s most active growth markets.


**About Newmark**
Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark’s comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of more than $3.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from over 195 offices with more than 10,000 professionals across four continents.
